sentences.sentence: **My Ego Sabotaged My Writing**
Illustration by Fresh Idea
Full manuscript in two months.
That was the goal.
I was on vacation in Mexico, no less, when I checked my email and saw the opportunity.
It was mid-June and the conference was happening near the end of August.
I had an idea I had always wanted to write about, an idea I had spent years thinking about.
It was going to be a bestseller.
I could feel it.
I always know when I have a winner.
And the deadline was near, but I could do it.
I'm a writer.
As I sat on the beach, sipping my margarita and staring out at the crystal-clear blue water, the excitement was building.
I was going to win this writing contest, I was going to make that money, and I was going to be famous.
I took out my phone and started typing.
But it wasn't what I wanted to type.
Instead of writing my book, I was scrolling through social media.
I was scrolling through my book's competition's social media.
I saw what they were doing, how they were marketing themselves, and how they were writing about themselves.
And I felt inadequate.
My book is better than that, I thought.
I'm a better writer than that.
And then the sabotaging began.
My ego started to talk to me.
"You can't do it," it said.
You re not good enough" They re going going to win anyway" You re a fake" You re not a real writer" I listened.
I listened to my ego and I didn t write.
I went back to my phone and I started texting.
I listened to my ego, and I didn't write.
I asked them if they thought I could do it.
And I got the answers I wanted.
They told me it was great, I was great, and I would win.
**What's Shaking Up the Hotel Industry: The Ever-Changing Landscape of Hospitality**
How prepared are you for the revolution?
Once upon a time, not that long ago, in the restaurant, food, and hospitality industry, the formula for success was pretty simple to grasp.
Following the formula was widely accepted as the guaranteed path to making it in the industry and succeeding big time.

That formula consisted of: location, location, location - a prime location in a busy area of town that would bring in the crowds; build, build, build - build a high-end, expensive, and nice restaurant with all the latest amenities to impress the crowd and then make sure your staff was well trained to give good service to the people that walked through the door.
If you had all three of these things then you would be set to make it in the food and hospitality business.
But that was then and this is now.
With the world of food and hospitality changing fast and getting faster, what we had learned was not so good anymore.
What is shaking up the hotel industry today is the way people are thinking and doing things.
For example, 40% of the people that come to the United States are from a foreign country.
They are not looking for a restaurant in a shopping mall or a strip mall.
They are looking for an experience when they come to the United States.
So that is what they want.
To give them an experience and to make money, you have to think different.
The way people are making money in the food and hotel business is by going against the formula.
You do not need a prime location to make it in the food and hotel business.
There are no customers to go to the restaurant in the morning when the work day is over at 5 o'clock.
But you can still make money with a food truck.
You can take the food truck to the customer.
Or the way that people are making money is by going online.
**Gathering Input from the Community: Shaping the Future of Vermont's Economic Groups Amidst a Pandemic-induced Crisis**
Gather input from organizations and partners across Vermont, to determine what these groups will be in Vermont.
Also Di Nov 25, 2020·3 min read

As the world waits for the results of COVID-19 vaccine clinical trials, we face a unique opportunity in Vermont to come together as a community and decide what role we want organizations and partners in our state to play.
Vermont's economy relies heavily on tourism, small businesses and farms, and the hospitality industry.
We have to make sure we keep all these industries going.
In the past year and a half, many different groups have helped us with ideas and ways to go forward.
Some said we should have people help at the store with the grocery shopping, but we know there is one store where you can do that, that is called curbside pickup.
When you use curbside pick up, you just go to the store and call them and they will bring your groceries to the car.
They will pack your car and you will not have to go in the store.
That is good, so this is a good thing that some groups did.
Now we have to think of what other groups to have.
Some people are saying we should have more groups to help with food, like people to help in the garden with the food.
Some people said we should have groups that can be in the house to help with the food so you can be safe, while you are at work.
This is a good idea too.
Now is the time to take all these ideas and find out what is the best.
We can find out who can help and how much they can help, and we can find out if they are good at it.
We will call this group we are making a "task force".
**How to Change Your Programming to Achieve the Results You Desire**
If negative thoughts turn into beliefs that determine your behavior, then the opposite holds true.
Positive thoughts and beliefs can lead to positive action.
This means we can reprogram our minds to achieve anything we desire, by simply changing our thoughts and patterns of thinking.
Reprogramming our minds to change our circumstances is a choice we can make, every day.
Two simple ways to reprogram your mind to do anything is by first becoming aware of your thoughts and second by replacing them with thoughts that will give you the results you desire.
**Step  1:  Become Aware of Your Thoughts**
The first step to reprogram your mind to do anything is to become aware of what you are thinking.
You can't change what you don't know.
So becoming aware of your thoughts is the first step.
You can do this by paying attention to what you are thinking during the day.
You can make a note of your thoughts and look for patterns in your thoughts.
Ask yourself is my thoughts are helping me achieve the results I want.
If you find that your thoughts are not helping you get the results you want then change them.
Change your thoughts to what will give you the results you want.
Once you become aware of your thoughts you can change them.
The more you can change them the faster you will get the results you want.
By changing your thoughts you will start to have the feelings that will give you the results you want and then the actions will be easy to follow.
Bec aware of what is good and what is bad.
If it is bad then stop it.
Don't have to have it.
Make the change and get what you want.
By thinking what is good is what I want.
Don't think what is not good.
Be a change and don't be a part of what  is not good.
There's nothing weird about owning a sex doll.
Most of us would, if they were cheaper.
A sex doll costs about as much as a car.
I'm talking high-end models, not the inflatable ones.
Those run around a hundred bucks.
Let's be real for a second, sex dolls have come a long way.
They used to be the stuff of sci-fi movies, plastic figures with wobbly limbs and no real-life experience.
Now they're not only realistic, they're advanced.
They have built-in Bluetooth, heating, and sensors that you can feel the pressure from.
They can kiss you, hug you, even whisper your name in your ear.
The technology that goes into making them is real.
And the most interesting thing is, no matter how much money you make, or how old you are, anyone can own a sex doll.
First of all, they can be beneficial to your sex life.
That may sound wrong, but hear me out.
If you're one of the millions of people who have no one to sleep with at the moment, they can be a good option.
You can pick a doll that you like, one that you think looks good, and one that you think will do it right.
They don't ever say no, and they don't leave you.
They don't get mad at you, or fight with you.
They just do it.
And if you are too old to have sex, or if you can't have sex for other reasons, they can be a good option too.
They can help you feel like you're a normal person, and that you can have sex like other people.
And don't think that they are for men only.
They are for women too.
A woman can buy a sex doll, and use it just the same way a man does.
They can be a good option for women who have never been able to have sex, or who can't have sex for other reasons.
**Embracing Empowerment: Being My Own Advocate**
Zion National Park in Utah, a place of breathtakingly breathtaking vistas, picture taken by yours truly.

As I look back on my journey, learning how to love me through the healing power of creative writing has proven to be a transformative experience that has shifted the game, not just about capturing a beautiful landscape but to also capture my life.

Learning how to love me has not always been easy, like some people hiking up to Angels Landing for the first time, you climb on, not sure how you will get down, but that is exactly how it felt for me, I was climbing on a steep climb to learn to love myself, but the view from the top is better then I ever thought possible.

Learning how to be my own advocate has been one of the biggest lessons I have learned, it's like standing on the edge of the Virgin River, deep in the canyon, to quiet to hear, but so loud that you feel, it's the sound of my life, and it's loud and clear, that I am worth more then what I have been told, I am worth more then what I have been through, and I am worth loving.
Learning how to be my own advocate is not a easy task, but it's a task that you have to do.
For me to feel alive I have to be my own advocate, to take control of my life, to take control of my feelings, to take control of me, I have to be my own advocate.
I have to be the person I was meant to be, not the person that I think others want me to be.
I have to be me.
Being my own advocate means, I have to talk, to talk about how I feel, to talk about what I need, to talk about what I want.
I have to be the one to do it.
**Salesman's Letter Series #1**
Dear Product Enthusiast,
How do you approach the salesman that sells a particular product you find lovely?
— is it that you buy because of humour or the way he introduces the product to you when he displays part of his ethos as a salesman?
Just know.
I have always found myself stuck in a situation of having so many items I like to buy; but I am just hesitant to just pick up my purse and start buying them.
One time I went to a store, there is a man that has a product in his hand and I was really excited about the product.
I started to go near him so that I can see the product.
He greeted me in a funny way and I really like his style.
He showed me the product and tell me it is so good.
I can really need it.
Then I start to feel like it's the time for me to buy the product.
The man just want to help me buy the product and I just want to get the product.
So I bought the product and I took it home, and after I have the product at home, I start to feel I make a good decision to buy the product because the man really do his best job.
Now I think I can make good decision when I meet a salesman.
I think the way the man handle me when I see the product and he is funny and want to help me I think I will buy the product because I like to have it.
The way he is, is so good and I will always go back to the store.
I can always say thank you to that man because he is my best seller.
I will go to him every time I have some money.
I will go to him and ask for his help to buy the product.
So, we have to look at the seller so that we will know what we are going to do.
He show us the way to buy the product.

1. Let the drama happen around you, not with you
It’s a bit embarrassing for me that Charice and Johann have witnessed my continued failures in love.
They have listened to my rants and given me compassionate advice in the six years we've been friends.
I keep wondering how do some people make it in their relationships, while I fail.
Do I make the wrong decisions, or am I just not good enough for love.
That’s why, after long thinking about it, I realized that in order to make a long term love life, there are 3 things you should do.
First one is to  Let the drama happen around you, not with you
This is a concept that I learned, when I was in my twenties,  that made me understand a lot of things, about my problems in love.
If we can't live without drama in our love life,  then we should not say we want a long term love, because the drama, will finish us.
I was always a part of the drama in my past relationships, because I was always looking for someone to blame for what was happening.
The problem was not my partner, the problem was me,  I was the one who was making the drama.
So I started to work in myself, and to understand what was my problem, and then I started to work in my attitude, to not let the drama happen in my love life, because I knew I could not take it.
Another one is to Love your Self
I think that we love our self, is the base for a long love life.
If we don't love our self, we can not love the other, in a good way.
I have been in a lot of relationships, and  I have always loved my self, but at the same time, I didn't like my self too.
I was confused,  and I didn't know, how to solve it.
**The Child is The Father of Man**
This in simple words means that the traits of childhood continue in manhood.
In other words, if we want to have better man we must first have better children.
If we pay no attention to the child, he grows into a wrong man.
So, it is the responsibility of the family to train the child good, teach him good manners, give him good knowledge, and keep him from going in the wrong way.
If the child grow well, when he grow up he will be a good man.
He will be a good citizen of the country.
A good family will be a good nation.
In our country today, we are suffering because of the bad man.
A bad man is made by a bad child.
A good man is made by a good child.
So, if we want to have a good country, we must start by teaching the child good.
We must teach the child to love his mother and father.
We must teach the child to respect his teacher.
We must teach the child to say yes to what is good and no to what is bad.
The child is a flower of the family.
If you give the flower good water and good sun, it will grow well.
But if you give the flower bad water and no sun, it will not grow.
This is the reason why education is very important.
Education is teaching and learning.
But here we mean education of the family, not of the school.
The family is the first school.
The mother and the father are the first teacher.
The child learns from the mother and the father first.
So, it is the duty of the mother and the father to teach the child good.
If the mother and the father do not teach the child good, who will teach him.
A child must learn to walk first, then to run.
A child must learn to read first, then to write.
A child must learn to be good first, then to be a man.
